facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action - material unwanted event control at P-4101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4101, M-4101 and P-4105 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. P-4101 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 7 February 2022 a corrective action on P-4101, M-4101 and P-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
